uploads.title: Taiwan’s Silicon Shield: The $5 Trillion War Deterrent #Shorts

learnings: State a dramatic number, dollar figure, or existential threat within the first 3 seconds of the script.
Frame complex geopolitical topics through the lens of tangible everyday stakes or technological chokepoints.
Keep Shorts scripts between 30 to 45 seconds to maintain high completion rates and reach over 85% average view duration.
Design the opening visual frame to function as an intriguing thumbnail on the Shorts shelf.
Structure the final line of the script to seamlessly loop back into the opening sentence to encourage repeat plays.
Place hashtags like #Shorts in the video description or at the very end of the title so the main hook remains readable.
double_down: ASML and the $350 Million Machines That Control the Global Microchip Supply
How Undersea Fiber Optic Cables Hold 99% of International Banking Systems
China's Monopoly on Rare Earth Metals and the Global Defense Tech Standoff
The Secret Malacca Strait Bottleneck: How 80% of East Asia's Oil Moves
avoid: Drawing conclusions from extremely small sample sizes before publishing at least 10–15 videos.
Generic title formats that sound like academic essays rather than high-stakes conflicts.
Slow-paced video intros without voiceover energy or visual motion in the first 2 seconds.
